socfpga_gpio.h

GPIO hardware abstraction driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

Constants
Instance configuration

Pin counts, bank selectors, and base addresses for the two GPIO banks.

GPIO_MAX_INSTANCE

Number of pins in the driver pin table.

GPIO_PINS_PER_REG

Number of pins in one GPIO bank.

GPIO_INSTANCE1

Bank selector for GPIO bank 0. Its value is 0.

GPIO_INSTANCE0

Bank selector for GPIO bank 1. Its value is 1.

GPIO0_BASE_ADDR

MMIO base address of GPIO bank 0.

GPIO1_BASE_ADDR

MMIO base address of GPIO bank 1.

Macros
GET_GPIO_BASE_ADDR

Resolves the physical base address for a specific pin index.

Constants
Pin multiplexer

Pinmux register address, the GPIO select value, and the field mask.

PINMUX_REG

Address of the pinmux register for pin p. Pins 0 to 39 start at 0x10D13000. Pins 40 and above start at 0x10D13100. Each pin is 4 bytes apart.

PINMUX_GPIO

Field value that selects GPIO.

PINMUX_MASK

Mask for the pin-function bits. The driver keeps these bits and compares them with the GPIO value.

Types
gpio_callback_t

Function signature invoked by the GPIO Interrupt Service Routine (ISR) when a configured hardware interrupt condition (e.g., rising edge, level high) is detected on a pin.

Parameters
state

The logical state of the pin at the time of the interrupt.

param

An opaque user pointer registered alongside the callback.

gpio_pin_t

Maps logical pin identifiers to their specific hardware positions within the underlying GPIO controllers. Pins 0-23 belong to GPIO0, and pins 24-47 belong to GPIO1.

gpio_dir_t

Specifies the electrical data direction of a GPIO pin. This maps directly to the `gpio_swportA_ddr` hardware register.

gpio_int_t

Defines the trigger condition for hardware-generated interrupts. This maps to the `inttype_level` and `int_polarity` registers.

gpio_ioctl_t

Control codes used to read or modify the active hardware configuration of an opened GPIO pin dynamically.

gpio_descriptor
struct
gpio_descriptor

An internal state-tracking structure maintaining the software context, ownership, and callback bindings for an individual GPIO pin.

Types
gpio_handle_t

An opaque software handle representing an active claim over a GPIO pin.  Required for subsequent dynamic configuration or teardown.

gpio_pin_t 
pin,

)

Configures the hardware interrupt logic for a specific pin. This safely performs the read-modify-write sequences across the `inttype_level`, `int_polarity`, and `inten` registers to program the hardware trigger.

Parameters
pin
gpio_pin_t

The logical pin identifier.

type
gpio_int_t

The hardware trigger condition from gpio_int_t.

Returns

true on success; false if the pin does not support interrupts or the type is invalid.

gpio_read_state
uint8_t gpio_read_state(
gpio_pin_t 
pin
)

Performs a direct read of the `ext_porta` register. This bypasses the data direction register to sample the true electrical state currently present on the physical pad, regardless of whether it is configured as an input or output.

Parameters
pin
gpio_pin_t

The logical pin identifier.

Returns

1 if the pad is driven high; 0 if the pad is driven low.

gpio_write_state
void gpio_write_state(
gpio_pin_t 
pin,
uint8_t 
state
)

Sets or clears the corresponding bit in the `gpio_swportA_dr` register. If the pin is configured as an output, this immediately drives the physical pad to the requested electrical state.

Parameters
pin
gpio_pin_t

The logical pin identifier.

state
uint8_t

1 to drive the pad high; 0 to drive the pad low.
